home.title: Eternal Sword Pact Guide
home.lead: A practical guide organized by systems, classes and activities. Values not demonstrated by the client are shown as ?.
sections: Using the guide
Choose a section from the menu as you would open a game feature. Each page brings together explanations, usage, relationships, items and available sources.
Game versions
Google Play/LDPlayer and LDStore are documented separately whenever their files or content differ.
Community
Chat is readable without an account. Secure access is used to write, save characters or report errors.

general.title: General guide
general.lead: Orientation for understanding the interface, progressing and deciding where to invest resources.
sections: First steps
Follow the main quests to open systems and keep materials whose purpose you do not yet understand. No unlock level is stated unless demonstrated.
Progression
Character power combines level, evolution stage, gear, skills, Spirit Root, Technique, SwordFlight, Zodiac, Spirits and other systems.
Resources
Always check an item's description and related system before spending it. This site's search contains items and goods only.

systems.title: Character systems
systems.lead: Reference centre for Stats, Skill, Spirit Root, Technique, SwordFlight, Zodiac, Spirit and Wisp.
sections: Relationships
Systems may share stats and materials, but direct relationships are shown only when supported by the client or documented observation.
Builds
Recommendations depend on class, PvE or PvP content and available stats. Unknown exact data remains ?.
Upgrades
Before upgrading, review the described effect, cost and whether the resource is used elsewhere.

stats.title: Stats
stats.lead: Stats describe offense, survival, accuracy, mitigation and system bonuses.
sections: Basic Stats
They include HP, ATK, S.A, DEF, CRIT, TEN, PEN, BLOCK and modifiers for damage, skills, Spirit, Transformation and Technique.
Special Stats
They include percentage bonuses, CRIT DMG, Stun, resistances, Suppression, EXP Boost and Stamina Points Bonus.
Choice
Compare the actual benefit for your class and mode; no universal priority is presented without evidence.

skill.title: Skill
skill.lead: Browse skills recovered from the client and their relationship to each class.
sections: By class
Dragon Lancer, Lunarborn, Spiritfox and Swordsage keep separate lists. A recovered name alone does not prove an exact rotation or priority.
Active and passive
Active skills are used in combat; passive skills modify the character or a mechanic when their conditions are met.
Build
Use demonstrated descriptions and test interactions in game. Missing multipliers or timings are shown as ?.

spirit-root.title: Spirit Root
spirit-root.lead: A root, upgrade and combination system related to stats and its own materials.
sections: Management
The interface includes upgrades, Fuse, Decompose, Resonance, Sacrifice and Core Spirit Root.
Materials
Check each item in the search before using it. A source is not assigned unless files demonstrate it.
Setup
Compare offered stats with the needs of your class and PvE or PvP mode.

technique.title: Technique
technique.lead: A normal and special Technique system using plants and upgrade materials.
sections: Use
Review each Technique's effect and cost before upgrading. Client names are preserved to connect them to items.
Plants
Plants are system resources; the search finds documented goods without mixing monsters or dungeons.
Priority
The best Technique depends on class and goal. Relationships not directly supported are not presented as exact.

swordflight.title: SwordFlight
swordflight.lead: Browse Vermilion Bird, Azure Dragon, Azure Bird, Black Tortoise, White Tiger and Soaring Snake.
sections: Function
SwordFlight brings together progression choices and bonuses. Each entry keeps its identity and sources.
Choice
Compare displayed stats and effects with your build; no universal best SwordFlight is invented.
Data
Unrecovered values or materials are shown as ?.

zodiac.title: Zodiac and Glyph
zodiac.lead: A transformation system with Glyph and entries such as Gonggong, Hou Yi and Western Queen.
sections: Transformations
Client relationships are preserved without claiming exact effects that are not described.
Glyph
Glyph belongs to Zodiac and should be compared by its available effects and stats.
PvE and PvP
Usefulness may change by mode; unknown values remain ?.

spirit.title: Spirit
spirit.lead: Manage Spirits through Basic, Upgrade, Array, Arraycore, Kismet, Evolution, Bond, Cleanse, Tier Up, Demoncore and Pill Array.
sections: Formation
Positions and Spirit relationships are checked through Array and documented links.
Progression
Check which resource each upgrade consumes and whether the change is reversible before confirming.
Missing data
Undemonstrated rates, limits or unlocks are represented by ?.

wisp.title: Wisp
wisp.lead: A system related to Wisp Array, Sprite, Summon, Sacrifice and associated access points.
sections: Use
The guide separates observed functions from relationships recovered from the client.
Upgrades
Review cost and visible result before consuming resources.
Rumor
Community-only explanations may be shown as Rumor rather than confirmed data.

equipment.title: Gear and upgrades
equipment.lead: Gear, Gem and Soul with pieces, rarities, tiers, stars, craft, materials and bonuses.
sections: Gear
Compare piece, tier, rarity, stars and stats before replacing it or using it as material.
Gem
Gems are socketed and upgraded in their system; benefit depends on type and available slot.
Soul
Gear Soul and Melting are documented without assigning a level or date requirement when it is not known exactly.

objects.title: Items and acquisition
objects.lead: Search exclusively for items, goods and materials. It never returns monsters or dungeons.
sections: Search
Enter a full or partial name and filter by category. Client names are preserved for comparison with the game.
Acquisition
A source is shown only when linked by files or documented observation; otherwise it appears as ?.
Variants
Google Play/LDPlayer and LDStore stay separate when an item or text differs.

bosses.title: Bosses
bosses.lead: A separate boss catalogue with variants linked to client monsters and their available statistics.
sections: Level and statistics
Each variant may show level, HP limit, DEF, RESIST and Toughness when recovered. Missing values appear as ?.
Damage by level
Level and defenses help compare variants, but the exact damage formula for level difference is not demonstrated and remains ?.
Preparation
Compare visible level, resistances and activity rules. Uninterpreted weaknesses are not presented as confirmed.

activities.title: Activities and dungeons
activities.lead: Daily Quest, Rage Boss, Time Realm, Ancient Ruins, Spirit Spring, Dungeons, PvP, Alliance War and Kunlun.
sections: Preparation
Review activity type, visible attempts, your build and demonstrated rewards before entering.
PvE
Balance survival and damage according to the objective, enemies and available time.
PvP
Client rules are separated from general advice; unavailable exact formulas are shown as ?.

classes.title: Classes
classes.lead: Compare Dragon Lancer, Lunarborn, Spiritfox and Swordsage.
sections: Identity
Each class keeps separate skills, stats and resources when the client establishes that relationship.
Build
Use the class page to combine Stats, Skill, Spirit Root, Technique, SwordFlight, Zodiac, PvE and PvP.
Choice
There is no universally best class; choice depends on style and content.

class.title: Class guide
class.lead: A build organized by skills, stats and related systems.
sections: Skills
The list comes from recovered client files. Undemonstrated exact rotations remain ?.
Stats
Choose stats that support the class role and skills, separating PvE and PvP needs.
Systems
Compare Spirit Root, Technique, SwordFlight and Zodiac by available effects; an inferred relationship is not presented as exact.

community.title: Community
community.lead: Player profiles, characters and guide conversations.
sections: Reading
Conversations are readable without signing in.
Participation
Secure access is used to write or save characters.
Profile
Each character can store name, class, realm or evolution stage, server and language.

project.title: Project
project.lead: An unofficial community guide created by PeRiCh and ChatGPT.
sections: Method
The guide links extracted files, video observations and retained sources. It does not fill exact data without evidence.
Sources
Sources and limitations appear in the small-print notes for each section or dataset.
Pending
Unknown values are marked ?. Unverified community contributions are presented as Rumor.
